high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from marktechpost.com, displaying information about the training data and phases used for mmBERT, a large language model. The content is structured into sections with headings and bullet points. Title: "What training data and phases were used?" Description: mmBERT was trained on 3 trillion tokens spanning 1,833 languages. Data sources include FineWeb2, Dolma, MegaWika v2, ProLong, StarCoder, and others. English makes up only ~10–34% of the corpus depending on the phase.
